quotes.text: When I mix, I'm not thinking about what the track needs. I'm thinking about what the room is going to do to it. Because the room always wins. You can put something in that sounds perfect in the control room and it turns into soup the moment someone plays it somewhere with a low ceiling. So I'm always mixing for the room I haven't heard yet.
